description: Use when benchmarking EHR maintenance costs before a contract renewal or evaluating health IT budget efficiency. Returns benchmark cost per licensed bed with optional gap analysis when actual cost and bed count are provided. Example: Epic maintenance median $4,500/bed — 300-bed hospital at $6,200/bed is 38% above market — renegotiation trigger especially strong at 5+ year renewal cycles. Source: KLAS 2024, Kaufman Hall EHR TCO composite. $0.02 USDC per call.
name: get_ehr_cost_per_bed
title: Get Ehr Cost Per Bed
